text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Feliz! ¡Año! ¡Nuevo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Happy New Year to you, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, let's head out right away!
To that classic New Year's tradition!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've already gotten the tickets, desu!

Without knowing what was going on,
the place I was brought to was—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Right there! Go for it!
Finishing hold!!
(Ding-dong-dang!)
For some reason, we ended up watching pro wrestling together...

"And after the match ended,
we decided to stroll around the adjacent amusement park."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! That was fiery hot!
When it comes to New Year's, pro wrestling is an absolute must!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I don't see this performance,
it just doesn't feel like the new year has started!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The growth of the young lions of this generation... Truly splendid! Truly passionate, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This kind of fresh rivalry is the true thrill of pro wrestling!
And it's what I've always dreamed of!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Someday, I want to battle Grass for the top belt, too, YES!
choice_data_list: Are you specifically nominating Grass Wonder for that?
Are you specifically picking Grass Wonder for that?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? That's true.
Another girl would be fine, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I think the scariest and most amazing one of all...
is probably Grass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Beneath that serene expression lies an unyielding, single-minded blue flame that will never burn out!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Living together with them,
I know that better than anyone!"

Her classmate and roommate,
Grass Wonder.

"Even with so many rivals around,
it seems El Condor Pasa sees Grass Wonder
as her greatest rival of all."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, speaking of which, Trainer-san,
since we went through the trouble of watching pro wrestling...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For New Year's, I want to practice
some pro wrestling moves, YES!
choice_data_list: Is that... actually going to help!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely stand! After all, my wrestler Papa
is an all-around ace at every sport, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, this is a real dilemma!
Please decide which pro-wrestling move
I should master!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, throwing techniques! Tossing various things around should really build up my legs and hips!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then let's do it right away!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: First is the weight throw, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
10kg, 20kg, 30kg—
with my power, it's totally no problem, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Next up, I'm throwing the seine net on the beach!
And backwards, at that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ready, and...
Fisherman's Suuuuplex!
(SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And finally... wha-wha-what is THIS?!
Taking on an ultra-sweet, super-gooey parfait~?!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fweeeh, no no to sweets, it stiiinks!
I'm throwing a trial like this in the trash, DEESU!

In the end, she ended up throwing
the training itself away. Having thrown so many things,
it seemed her power was boosted.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, ground grappling! Submissions are indeed essential!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Escape, or give up?! Trainer,
put a hold on me!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugggh... This is... tough, yes.
I'm so stiff I can barely move, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't underestimate Elle-Elle!
Something like this... something like thiiis~~!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Khhh... khhh... Look, I managed to slip out... yeppers. Fshuuu...

While struggling through it, I ended up falling asleep.
Unexpectedly, it seems to have relieved my fatigue.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, tag-team moves! Synergy with the Trainer is truly vital!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's take on all sorts of new challenges together this New Year!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Alright, first up is karaoke!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Duets, harmonies,
and lively call-and-response, cha-cha-cha!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Next is co-op play!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fighting games, taiko drums,
and gun shooters!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance together, too!
In sync now... and lift up!
After trying out various combo techniques, it seems they learned a variety of movement patterns.
